description: This is a Perl script for flashing and interacting with Fritz!Box and D-Link DSL-G6x4T devices. It performs network discovery via UDP broadcasts, communicates with the devices using FTP, and uploads firmware files to the device's memory partitions.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP customized with additional commands for interacting with the ADAM2 device, including environment variable retrieval, reboot, and flash check functionalities.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Sends the USER command in FTP session.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method to get environment variables.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs a flash memory check using FTP.
